title: Week 19 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “scarcity”?
options: The condition that available resources are insufficient to satisfy every possible want.
Demonstrated ability to apply civic knowledge and reasoning to institutions, documents, cases, and participation.
The phrasing and order of survey questions, which can influence responses.
The difference between willingness to pay and the price actually paid.
questions.explanation: Scarcity means the condition that available resources are insufficient to satisfy every possible want.
choices: The condition that available resources are insufficient to satisfy every possible want.
Demonstrated ability to apply civic knowledge and reasoning to institutions, documents, cases, and participation.
The phrasing and order of survey questions, which can influence responses.
The difference between willingness to pay and the price actually paid.

The constitutional protection of legal assistance in specified criminal proceedings.

A value-based claim about what ought to be.

questions.question: Which action best demonstrates mastery of the Week 19 inquiry?
options: A student accepts the first available claim or offer without checking the source, terms, evidence, or consequences.
A student selects an answer only because it sounds confident, even when the record is incomplete or contradictory.
A student relies on political identity, advertising, or personal preference as a substitute for documented analysis.
A student identifies the best forgone alternative and separates testable predictions from value judgments.
